skills.purpose: Interpret a supported synthetic direct-mail task as a brief, clarification or unsupported request.
guidance: Use supported segment playbooks and preserve the user's objective.
Ask for an explicit absolute GBP budget when missing or ambiguous.
Return a proposal only. Never infer approval or execution permission.

skills.purpose: Draft contrasting audience hooks using frozen context and source-bound product wording.
guidance: Read editorial context before submitting a pair.
Generate situational framing, select supplied fact IDs and leave factual wording to code.
Treat preferences and synthetic outcomes as advisory. Screen the pair before publication.

skills.purpose: Revise a selected hook while preserving the sibling, product wording and experiment.
guidance: Apply the explicit targeted feedback as a preference, never policy or product evidence.
Preserve the sibling hook and both selected fact IDs. Screen the resulting complete pair.
A rewrite is unapproved and cannot inherit outcomes.
